newsitem.title: FRANCE: UIC shares slide after H1 data.
newsitem.headline: UIC shares slide after H1 data.

text.p: Union Industrielle de Credit (UIC), the property financing arm of insurer GAN, retraced some losses after tumbling 18.7 percent following a net attributable first-half loss of 758 million francs.

UIC, 97-percent-owned by GAN, reported the loss after the market's close on Monday. It also said that a recapitalisation announced in April would total 800 million francs which commentators said was larger than expected.
After hitting a low of 51.05 francs UIC remained the day's weakest stock with a fall of 11.6 percent to 55.5 francs on volume of 3,611 shares.
